title: The Beasts
lead: Thērion, "wild beast," appears 39 times. Revelation has a beast from the abyss (11:7), a beast from the sea (13:1), a beast from the earth (13:11, later called the false prophet), and a scarlet beast (17:3) that seems to be the sea beast in its final form. The study page "The beasts" lays out every reading; this page summarizes.
